segments.sn24.19:1.2: “Kismiṃ nu kho, bhikkhave, sati, kiṃ upādāya, kiṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati –
segments.sn24.19:1.3: ‘na vātā vāyanti, na najjo sandanti, na gabbhiniyo vijāyanti, na candimasūriyā udenti vā apenti vā, esikaṭṭhāyiṭṭhitā’”ti?
segments.sn24.19:1.4: Bhagavaṃmūlakā no, bhante, dhammā … pe …“rūpe kho, bhikkhave, sati, rūpaṃ upādāya, rūpaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati –
segments.sn24.19:2.3: Vedanāya sati … pe … saññāya sati … pe … saṅkhāresu sati … viññāṇe sati, viññāṇaṃ upādāya, viññāṇaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati –
segments.sn24.19:3.1: “Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn24.19:3.3: “Aniccaṃ, bhante”… pe … vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya – na vātā vāyanti … pe … esikaṭṭhāyiṭṭhitā”ti?
segments.sn24.19:3.7: “Iti kho, bhikkhave, dukkhe sati, dukkhaṃ upādāya, dukkhaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati –
segments.sn24.19:3.9: “Vedanā … saññā … saṅkhārā … viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn24.19:3.13: “Aniccaṃ, bhante”… pe … vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya ‘na vātā vāyanti … pe … esikaṭṭhāyiṭṭhitā’”ti?
segments.sn24.19:3.17: “Iti kho, bhikkhave, dukkhe sati, dukkhaṃ upādāya, dukkhaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya –
segments.sn24.19:3.18: ‘na vātā vāyanti, na najjo sandanti, na gabbhiniyo vijāyanti, na candimasūriyā udenti vā apenti vā, esikaṭṭhāyiṭṭhitā’”ti.
segments.sn24.19:3.19: Paṭhamaṃ. 225-240.(Purimavagge viya aṭṭhārasa veyyākaraṇāni vitthāretabbānīti.) Sattarasamaṃ.

lines: Rūpī ca arūpī cāti ārammaṇañca jhānañca “attā”ti gahitadiṭṭhi.
Jhānalābhinopi hi atīte ekantasukhaṃ attabhāvaṃ manasikaroto evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati.
Takkinopi “yathā etarahi ahaṃ ekantasukhī, evaṃ samparāyepi bhavissāmī”ti uppajjati.
Jātissarassapi sattaṭṭhabhave sukhitabhāvaṃ passantassa evaṃ uppajjati, ekantadukkhītiādīsupi eseva nayo.
Tatrāpi aṭṭhāraseva veyyākaraṇāni, tato parāni “rūpī attā hotī”tiādīni aṭṭha veyyākaraṇāni, tehi saddhiṃ taṃ dutiyapeyyāloti vutto.
224-301. Dukkhavasena vuttanti “iti kho, bhikkhave, dukkhe sati dukkhaṃ upādāyā”tiādidukkhavasena vuttaṃ.
